```plato

//==
// # Rigid poses
//
// Position plus rotation: the natural "where is this object" transform, in the
// plane and in space. Composition preserves distances and angles, so a pose is
// the representation to reach for whenever no scale or shear is wanted. The
// operations live in `transforms.library.plato`.

// A rigid placement in the plane: position plus rotation. Also known as a 2D
// rigid transform (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rigid_transformation).
type Pose2D
    implements IValue, IInterpolatable, IRigid2D
{
    Position: Point2D;
    Rotation: Rotation2D;
}
```
